rationale: Post-contingency state (with l13 out) causes l12 to be overloaded at 133.3% of its 75 MW rating. Closing the normally-open tie l14 creates an alternative path from bus 1 to bus 4, reducing the flow on l12 to 70.71 MW (94.3% loading) and bringing all branches within their ratings. Opening any branch (l23, l24, or l34) would worsen or maintain the overload on l12.
